provenance.operator: lazy random walk on cosine of binary descendant-concept memberships; diagonal removed before laziness
provenance.membershipConstruction: Research Areas concepts directly assigned to each active discipline; SKOS narrower/broader descendant closure; no embeddings or paper counts.
provenance.coordinateTransform: Eigenvector signs fixed by largest absolute entry; each disconnected component centered and uniformly scaled, then packed on a deterministic grid.

limitations: Vocabulary/classification overview, not empirical all-physics paper geometry.
Broad/narrow and shared-concept relations do not imply scientific dependence, truth or question equivalence.
Two dimensions distort the recorded membership geometry; diagnostics report within-component loss.
Between disconnected components, grid spacing is display packing only.
Coordinates cannot be compared with the separate Swampland source-geometry chart.
Discipline concept counts reflect taxonomy granularity, not research volume or importance.
